question: Which daily quota applies to the LatLng Free plan, and what does its sign-up form ask for? unverified: behind a sign-up
why: The terms table gives 3,000 forward geocodes, 300 reverse geocodes and 100 places searches a day, while the docs describe one unified pool of 3,000 total API calls a day; a call without a key returned x-ratelimit-limit 60 where the SDK page says 30 geocodes a day. The dashboard at dash.latlng.work is a JavaScript sign-in page whose fields and quota meter are not in the page text, and an account is needed to read them.
